features.title: Platform Foundation and Environments
features.user_visible_behavior: Users can open the application, receive a healthy response from the API, and see a clear service-unavailable state when a required dependency is unhealthy.
verification: Run `./init.sh`.
Install dependencies using the repository-documented command.
Run the frontend and API build, lint, type-check, and test commands.
Start the local stack and verify the frontend and API health endpoints.
Temporarily withhold a required dependency configuration and verify a safe readiness failure.
Validate the AWS infrastructure definition without deploying production resources.

features.title: Company Identity and Membership
features.user_visible_behavior: An administrator creates a company, invites coworkers, assigns roles, and removes access; invited members sign in with Google and enter only their company workspace.
verification: Run the backend authentication and authorization test suites.
Exercise company creation, invite acceptance, invite revocation, role change, member removal, and sign-out.
Attempt cross-company reads and writes with valid sessions and verify denial.
Verify the final-administrator safeguard.
Complete the Google sign-in and invitation flow in a browser.

features.title: Notion Knowledge Connection and Sync
features.user_visible_behavior: An administrator connects Notion, chooses approved sources, sees synchronization status, and can remove access; members can later receive answers linked to the approved originals.
verification: Run unit tests for source selection, normalization, idempotency, and deletion handling.
Run integration tests against a controlled Notion test workspace.
Import a page and database, edit them, remove one, and verify each resulting knowledge state.
Simulate throttling and temporary Notion failures and verify bounded retries.
Verify company isolation with two connected test companies.
Complete connection, selection, status, and disconnection flows in a browser.

features.title: App Shell and Company Administration
features.user_visible_behavior: Members land in a responsive company workspace with clear navigation; administrators can manage people, Notion sources, and company settings from dedicated screens.
verification: Run frontend lint, type-check, component, and route tests.
Verify member and administrator navigation with separate test accounts.
Exercise loading, empty, populated, permission-denied, and API-failure states.
Test primary screens at desktop and mobile viewport widths in a browser.
Complete people, Notion source, company, and profile flows in the browser.
Run the configured accessibility checks for primary routes.

features.title: Meeting Scheduling and Lifecycle
features.user_visible_behavior: Members create instant or scheduled meetings inside Second Brain AI, invite coworkers, and see accurate upcoming, active, ended, and cancelled states.
verification: Run meeting service and authorization unit tests.
Run API integration tests for create, update, cancel, start, end, list, and detail flows.
Attempt invalid lifecycle transitions and cross-company access.
Retry start/end events and verify idempotent state.
Create instant and scheduled meetings through the browser and verify list/detail updates.

features.title: LiveKit Meeting Room
features.user_visible_behavior: Invited members join a Second Brain AI meeting with audio, video, screen sharing, participant controls, and a persistent meeting thread.
verification: Run frontend and token-authorization tests.
Join the same test meeting with at least two authenticated participants.
Exercise microphone, camera, screen sharing, thread messaging, reconnect, leave, and end controls.
Attempt joining as an uninvited member and from another company.
Verify thread persistence after leaving and re-entering.
Exercise the room at desktop and mobile viewport widths in a browser.

features.title: AI Meeting Memory and Citations
features.user_visible_behavior: When a participant directly addresses CC, it answers concisely from approved company knowledge, cites the supporting sources, and admits when it cannot verify an answer.
verification: Run direct-address, retrieval filtering, grounding, citation, and no-answer unit tests.
Run integration tests with controlled Notion and prior-meeting fixtures for two companies.
Ask supported, unsupported, ambiguous, and cross-company questions in a LiveKit test meeting.
Verify CC remains silent during unaddressed conversation.
Verify text-originated requests receive persistent thread responses.
Simulate retrieval and model-provider failures and verify safe degradation.

features.title: Structured Meeting Records
features.user_visible_behavior: After a meeting ends, participants can open its transcript, summary, decisions, action items, and citations; future retrieval can use the approved record.
verification: Run transcript, extraction, citation, idempotency, authorization, and retry tests.
Complete a controlled multi-speaker meeting and compare the produced record with the known transcript.
Repeat the meeting-ended event and verify only one canonical record.
Force partial and failed processing states and verify recovery behavior.
Verify raw media deletion after processing.
Open the finished record in a browser and follow its transcript and knowledge citations.

features.title: Company Knowledge Assistant
features.user_visible_behavior: Members ask company questions in a dedicated assistant, receive concise cited answers, inspect the supporting sources, and continue a conversation without losing context.
verification: Run assistant conversation, authorization, retrieval, citation, and source-removal tests.
Ask controlled questions answerable by Notion, prior meetings, both source types, and neither.
Verify multi-turn context without allowing earlier conversation text to bypass source restrictions.
Remove an approved source and verify it no longer supports new answers.
Attempt cross-company conversation and source access.
Exercise desktop and mobile assistant flows in a browser.

features.title: Channels and Direct Messages
features.user_visible_behavior: Members communicate in channels and direct messages, see unread activity, and reference meetings, records, approved knowledge, decisions, and action items.
verification: Run channel, direct-message, membership, authorization, delivery, unread, and search tests.
Exercise public channel, private channel, and direct-message flows with multiple members.
Attempt private-channel, direct-message, and cross-company access as unauthorized users.
Test reconnect, duplicate-send, pagination, and concurrent-message behavior.
Verify references to meetings and knowledge preserve target authorization.
Complete desktop and mobile messaging flows in a browser.

features.title: Decision and Action System
features.user_visible_behavior: Members can see what was decided, who owns each action, its current status and reminders, and the source history connecting it to meetings, knowledge, and collaboration.
verification: Run decision, action-item, history, reminder, authorization, and idempotency tests.
Promote extracted meeting outcomes into canonical records and verify source traceability.
Exercise assignment, status changes, due dates, completion, reopen, and archive flows.
Advance test time and verify reminder scheduling, deduplication, and preference handling.
Attempt unauthorized and cross-company reads and mutations.
Complete personal and company decision/action workflows in a browser.
